title: CSV to Markdown
description: Convert CSV to a Markdown table — proper parsing of quoted commas, escaped quotes and multiline fields.
howto: Choose column alignment and whether the first row is a header.
Copy it or download as table.md.

faqs.a: With a real CSV parser: fields wrapped in double quotes may contain commas, newlines and escaped "" quotes.

faqs.q: What if my CSV has no header row?
faqs.a: Untick "first row is header" and generic Column 1…N headers are used.
Left, center or right — applied to every column via the separator row (:---, :---:, ---:).
Optional — tick "trim cells" to strip surrounding whitespace from every field.
